rows.note: Use 假期 as the all-purpose noun for time off, including a school break when no school-specific wording is needed.

example.english: We have a whole month of holiday in the summer, so we can travel.
example.traditional: 我哋暑假有成個月假期，可以去旅行。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 syu2 gaa3 jau5 seng4 go3 jyut6 gaa3 kei4 ho2 ji5 heoi3 leoi5 hang4

rows.note: Use 公眾假期 specifically for an official day off declared for the general public.

example.english: Tomorrow is a public holiday, so we don't have to work.
example.traditional: 聽日係公眾假期，唔使返工。
example.jyutping: ting1 jat6 hai6 gung1 zung3 gaa3 kei4 m4 sai2 faan1 gung1

rows.note: Use 節日 for a religious or traditional festival day rather than a period of time off work.

example.english: The Mid-Autumn Festival is my favourite holiday.
example.traditional: 中秋節係我最鍾意嘅節日。
example.jyutping: zung1 cau1 zit3 hai6 ngo5 zeoi3 zung1 ji3 ge3 zit3 jat6

rows.note: Use 學校假期 when the holiday period specifically refers to a school break.

example.english: The school holiday has started, so we can finally sleep in.
example.traditional: 學校假期開始喇，我哋終於可以瞓晏啲。
example.jyutping: hok6 haau6 gaa3 kei4 hoi1 ci2 laa3 ngo5 dei6 zung1 jyu1 ho2 ji5 fan3 aan3 di1
